pages.title: The work
pages.text:
**Assignment list:** chapter **Strand: Spark**. A peer path.

Strike a Drumheart before you touch a wire. Spirit Pulse is the power here; Powah and Mekanism are bridges you cross later, if you want.

Bone Chime, Spirit Shard, Copper Resonator, Drumheart. Leather for the Drumheart: smelt rotten flesh, or sieve dirt with flint mesh. Finish the **Spark Knot** and seat Spark. Then listen.

pages.title: Hum
pages.text: The Drumhearts kept the beat under the whole sky. The drum is not loud. The drum is steady. Be the drum.
